title: Fantasiestücke - No. 3 Warum?
notable_excerpt: Key: D-flat major. Chord journey: bbvii - bbvi5 - bbII6#64 - bbII#3 - bbVII6 - bbvi4 - bbiii64 - bbVI6 - bbII - bIV - bbvii#5 - bbiii43 - bbvi5 - bbII6#64, questioning cadences that pause without resolving. Texture: melodic line over arpeggiated accompaniment with a lingering bass.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #29770 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1879), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~97%, pitch ~91% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op12_fantasiestuecke_3.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Fantasiestücke Op. 12. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
